samples.xml_description:
<module id="radix2_div">
    <description>Implements a simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed/unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst">Reset signal.</input>
        <input id="sign">Sign mode selection (1 for signed, 0 for unsigned).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">Dividend input.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">Divisor input.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">Valid operation signal.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">Result validity signal.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">Result containing remainder and quotient.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE">Division state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DONE">Done state.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="sign_reg" width_description="[0:0]">Register to hold the sign mode.</reg>
        <reg id="dividend_reg" width_description="[7:0]">Register to hold the dividend.</reg>
        <reg id="divisor_reg" width_description="[7:0]">Register to hold the divisor.</reg>
        <reg id="neg_divisor_reg" width_description="[8:0]">Register to hold the negative divisor.</reg>
        <reg id="sr_reg" width_description="[16:0]">Shift register for division.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt_reg" width_description="[3:0]">Counter for iterations.</reg>
        <reg id="start_cnt_reg" width_description="[0:0]">Start counter flag.</reg>
        <reg id="res_valid_reg" width_description="[0:0]">Result validity register.</reg>
        <reg id="result_reg" width_description="[15:0]">Result register.</reg>
        
        // Combinational logic assignments
        <assign id="result" src="result_reg"/>
        <assign id="res_valid" src="res_valid_reg"/>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        Always block triggered on the rising edge of the clock or reset
        if (rst == 1'b1) begin
            // Reset all registers and flags
            sign_reg <= 1'b0;
            dividend_reg <= 8'h00;
            divisor_reg <= 8'h00;
            neg_divisor_reg <= 9'h000;
            sr_reg <= 17'h00000;
            cnt_reg <= 4'h0;
            start_cnt_reg <= 1'b0;
            res_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
            result_reg <= 16'h0000;
        end else begin
            // Check if there's a valid operation and result isn't valid
            if ((opn_valid == 1'b1) && (res_valid_reg == 1'b0)) begin
                // Save the sign mode
                sign_reg <= sign;
                
                // Save the dividend and divisor
                dividend_reg <= dividend;
                divisor_reg <= divisor;
                
                // Calculate the negative divisor
                if (sign_reg == 1'b1) begin
                    neg_divisor_reg <= {1'b1, ~divisor_reg} + 1;
                end else begin
                    neg_divisor_reg <= {1'b0, divisor_reg};
                end
                
                // Initialize the shift register with the dividend
                sr_reg <= {8'h00, dividend_reg, 1'b0}; // Shift left by 1 bit
                cnt_reg <= 4'd1; // Set counter to 1
                start_cnt_reg <= 1'b1; // Set start counter flag
            end
            
            // Division process
            if (start_cnt_reg == 1'b1) begin
                // Check if the most significant bit of the counter is set
                if (cnt_reg[3] == 1'b1) begin
                    // Clear the counter and start counter flag
                    cnt_reg <= 4'd0;
                    start_cnt_reg <= 1'b0;
                    
                    // Update the result register with the remainder and quotient
                    result_reg <= {sr_reg[15:8], sr_reg[7]};
                    res_valid_reg <= 1'b1; // Set result validity
                end else begin
                    // Increment the counter
                    cnt_reg <= cnt_reg + 1;
                    
                    // Perform subtraction
                    if (sr_reg[16] == 1'b0) begin
                        sr_reg <= sr_reg - neg_divisor_reg;
                    end
                    
                    // Multiplexing logic to select between subtracted value and current shift register
                    if (sr_reg[16] == 1'b0) begin
                        sr_reg <= {sr_reg[15:0], 1'b1}; // Insert carry-out
                    end else begin
                        sr_reg <= {sr_reg[15:0], 1'b0}; // Insert zero
                    end
                end
            end
            
            // Manage result validity
            if (rst == 1'b1 || cnt_reg != 4'd0 || start_cnt_reg == 1'b1) begin
                res_valid_reg <= 1'b0; // Reset result validity
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
